text:
Lara: FYI seeing a big spike of WS reconnects from EU clients since the canary rolled at 10:23. Many of them show a server 'nack' frame just before the client reconnects.
Matt: Do you have logs/console link? which route/tenant?
Lara: https://console.redwood.example/requests/tenant-47
Lara: Sample from edge logs:
```
[2026-03-21T10:23:11Z] conn=abc123 close=4001 reason="nack:server-busy"
[2026-03-21T10:23:11Z] conn=abc123 reconnect
[2026-03-21T10:23:12Z] conn=def456 close=4001 reason="nack:server-busy"
```
Swathi: Hmm. The proxy currently returns a NACK to the client when the per-route inflight queue > max. That causes clients to immediately reconnect (no backoff).
Kai: That's rough. Immediate reconnects amplify load — thundering herd. We probably shouldn't NACK. Options: 1) drop frames silently and let client idle timeout, 2) return a 503 with `Retry-After`, or 3) push a small exponential-backoff header so SDKs behave.
Matt: SDKs currently treat any close code as immediate reconnect with jitter ~50-200ms. We need server-side signals.
Swathi: We could flip the proxy behavior behind a rollout flag `suppress-nack`. Config suggestion:
```
proxy.route.max_inflight: 500
proxy.route.suppress_nack: true
proxy.route.backpressure_ttl_ms: 2000
```
Lara: If we suppress NACK, do we risk queuing too long and OOM? Kai?
Kai: Exactly — if we queue unbounded we'll OOM. Use TTL + soft-drop. E.g. enqueue up to 100 then start 50% drop then NACK as last resort. Also surface `queue_depth` metric per route.
Lara: Billing note: the reconnects are triggering duplicate token usage for the same request and driving up per-token billing for some tenants.
Matt: We should dedupe resume tokens server-side for a 5s window. That will prevent double-charging on immediate reconnect.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for canary-2026-03-21-2 (reason: reconnect surge) :rotating_light:
Swathi: OK I'll prepare a rollout: 1) add `suppress-nack` flag + `backpressure_ttl` + queue metrics, 2) add resume-token dedupe 3) update SDK to honor `Retry-After` header. Rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with monitoring.
Kai: Add grafana alert: `rate(ws_reconnects[1m]) > 50/min` per tenant and `queue_depth > 80%` per route. Also add a dashboard panel for `nack_count` vs `suppress_nack_count`.
Lara: SGTM. Who owns the console flag UI? @Matt
Matt: I'll wire the flag to console and add a toggle with explanation. Also will add a "Reconnect rate" per-tenant card.
Lara: Thanks — action items: Swathi implement proxy changes, Kai add metrics/alerts, Matt console feature + tenant card, Swathi + Matt coordinate SDK header, QA smoke test with synthetic client that reconnects when it sees `nack`.
Kai: I'll also add a small chaos test to the canary harness to simulate high inflight queue.
Lara: Cool. Follow up in #eng-platform-releases once we have a PR. :thumbsup:
